hypotheses.claim: After a WM disputes a shadow-use row, the loser SE's van stock stays decremented — reload the SE van stock and the qty is still short.
hypotheses.strongestAlternative: a restore runs elsewhere — a cron sweep, a Prisma middleware, or a DB trigger keyed on status DISPUTED
hypotheses.altCheck: grep -rn seVanStock apps/backend/src excluding src/generated returns exactly 3 writer sites (inventory.service.ts reads, troubleshoot-submission.service.ts:377 decrement, verification.service.ts:409 rollback upsert); no @Cron in inventory/ or component-request/

hypotheses.claim: Marking a request SHIPPED produces no Notification row, so the SE sees it only by opening the Stock tab.
hypotheses.strongestAlternative: the notification is emitted generically from the audit write, so any COMPONENT_REQUEST_SHIPPED audit row fans out without a module-level call
hypotheses.altCheck: grep -rn NotificationService apps/backend/src excluding generated + notifications/ lists 8 injection sites, none in component-request/ or inventory/; grep auditLog inside apps/backend/src/notifications/*.ts returns nothing

hypotheses.claim: PATCH /api/inventory/warehouse-stock is truly closed to a ZONAL_MANAGER — the write is WM/OH only despite the static sheet printing READ_ROLES.
hypotheses.strongestAlternative: the RoleGuard is not actually applied on this handler, so the decorator is decorative

hypotheses.claim: Confirming warehouse receipt of a recovered device adds nothing to zone warehouse stock — the stock table is unchanged after the ticket auto-closes.
hypotheses.strongestAlternative: recovered units are meant to land in a separate asset/device ledger, not zone warehouse stock, so nothing is missing
hypotheses.altCheck: grep -rn inventoryTransaction apps/backend/src excluding generated returns writers only in shadow-use.service.ts, troubleshoot-submission.service.ts and verification.service.ts — recovery.service.ts touches neither that table nor zoneWarehouseStock
